text_en: Amazon EC2 P5 instances are powered by NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs and are ideal for training generative AI models.
text_zh: Amazon EC2 P5 实例由 NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU 提供支持，非常适合训练生成式 AI 模型。

text_en: Azure Blob Storage is available in multiple regions. It supports hot, cool, and archive access tiers.
text_zh: Azure Blob Storage 在多个区域可用，支持热、冷和存档访问层级。

text_en: Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service. It supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and SQL Server.
text_zh: Amazon RDS 是一项托管关系型数据库服务，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB、Oracle 和 SQL Server。
